name: Ben Lawson

experience.title: Employee Development Initiatives Specialist
experience.badge: Gemini Ambassador and HR AI Ambassador
bullets: Built multiple AI workflows (Gemini, Apps Script) as HR AI Ambassador automating HR processes, including one that cut manual effort by about 95%. Developing a hands-on workshop to help HR leaders build their own AI workflows.

Selected as one of three founding members to define Airbus's enterprise learning operations framework, setting org-wide standards for learning intake, needs assessment, assignment governance (request and approval rights), annual assignment calendars, and SCORM content structure.
Project managed a leadership development program, coordinating cross-functional teams and external facilitators to upskill 28 leaders.
Designed and facilitated programs and workshops on AI enablement and upskilling, mentorship, and presentation skills, for groups of 3 to 60.

experience.title: AI Tutor / Quality & Evaluation Specialist
bullets: Trained and evaluated Grok, xAI's large language model, across 21,000+ multimodal tasks for executive-visible projects, achieving 98% alignment and converting findings into process improvements.
Reviewed and assessed other trainers' work as an informal senior reviewer, and was selected for special projects, establishing project guidelines and documentation.

experience.org: Bank of the West (acquired by BMO)
experience.title: Product Owner, Learning & Development / Release Specialist
bullets: Owned the exit survey program for about 5,000 employees, from survey design and vendor platform to retention reporting for HR leadership. Built the retention dashboards in Power BI.

Designed, produced, and facilitated 20+ virtual and in-person learning programs on leadership, compliance, mentorship, communications, and environmental impact. Built content in Articulate and delivered it over Zoom, Webex, and Teams, with consistently high participant feedback.

Geo chair, Omaha Aspire ERG: led a team of 4 serving 200+ active members.
Began in BSA/AML at the bank before moving into HR.
